issues: Uses dynamic Tailwind class strings like `bg-${kindColor(d.kind)}-50 text-${kindColor(d.kind)}-700 border-${kindColor(d.kind)}-200` for available-doc kind badges (line ~284). Tailwind JIT purges classes it can't statically detect, so these color chips may render unstyled unless the classes are safelisted or hard-coded per branch. Verify against Tailwind config; likely low visual impact (chip becomes uncolored) but worth fixing.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Replace dynamic Tailwind color strings in PhaseFormModal available-doc kind chips with a static map or add safelist entries for bg-{indigo|amber|rose}-50/text-{...}-700/border-{...}-200.
critical_code_review_comments: PhaseFormModal.jsx uses dynamic Tailwind class interpolation for kind color badges — Tailwind JIT will not compile those class names unless safelisted. Static branch or explicit safelist recommended.
Both modals correctly implement 3 dismiss paths (X, Escape, backdrop) and disable submit for required-field validation. Good.
Backend phase create/update correctly handles '' and null as clear signals, converting to None. Good.
Backend create_phase computes sort_order via count_documents — not atomic; theoretical race on parallel creates could yield duplicate sort_order (existing behavior, not new).
